question: Which LVGL style property carries the text font on this v8 image?
prototype_hypothesis: Properties 0x5a (used earlier by the Manager backend, by analogy with 3.1.28) and 0x55 are text_decor and text_color; text_font is 0x57.
callsite_evidence: The table entry for text_font is 0x30057 (name pointer 0x2C75A826): type 3 (pointer), property 0x57, same neighbours as 3.1.32.
Setting the Manager label font with property 0x5a rendered the font pointer as a text colour (the dim page frames came out green); with 0x55 the font was still not applied.
After switching to 0x57 the Manager overview renders its Chinese text (系统信息 / 管理 / 模块 / 安装软件包 / 导入手机推送) and tapping 模块 opens the 已安装模块 sub-page on 3.1.32.
control_flow_evidence: name->(type<<16|prop) table lookup feeds lv_obj_set_local_style_prop(obj, prop, value, selector).
unsafe_assumptions: 0x57 is verified on 3.1.32 (rendered); on 3.1.190 it is taken from the same table pattern and not yet exercised on a page.
recommended_probe: Render the Manager page on 3.1.190 and confirm Chinese text.
